title: Undertale Intro Boom
blurb: Toby Fox opens Undertale with one deep impact, and it does more work than most games manage with a full orchestra. It is all weight and no fanfare. The rest of the soundtrack behaves the same way: sparse, deliberate, built in a tracker by one person who knew what every sound was for. The boom sets the tone before you have seen anything — something old, something serious, something that will remember what you did. Drop it before a dramatic reveal, or use it to lend an ordinary announcement the weight of an ending you cannot undo.
origin: The intro impact from Undertale (Toby Fox).
